title: Sleepy parrot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sleepy parrot, perched, eyes closed, soft rounded shapes -->
  <!-- tail feathers -->
  <path d='M60 72 Q78 88 70 96 Q62 88 58 78 Z' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <path d='M64 70 Q84 80 82 92 Q72 86 62 76 Z' fill='#3CB371'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='62' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#E8453C'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <path d='M56 50 Q72 56 70 72 Q62 66 58 58 Z' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <path d='M58 54 Q68 60 66 70 Q62 64 60 58 Z' fill='#3CB371'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='17' fill='#E8453C'/>
  <!-- cheek / face lighter -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='37' r='12' fill='#FF6F61'/>
  <!-- closed eye (sleepy arc) -->
  <path d='M31 32 Q35 37 40 32' stroke='#5A1020' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 32 Q50 37 55 32' stroke='#5A1020' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sleepy blush -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='40' r='3' fill='#FF9E8A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='40' r='3' fill='#FF9E8A'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M36 42 Q42 50 48 42 Q42 45 36 42 Z' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <path d='M36 42 Q42 47 48 42' stroke='#C99A1E' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head crest / feathers -->
  <path d='M42 18 Q44 10 50 14 Q46 18 46 22 Z' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <path d='M36 19 Q36 11 42 13 Q40 18 40 22 Z' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <!-- little branch perch -->
  <rect x='18' y='82' width='60' height='6' rx='3' fill='#A0673B'/>
  <rect x='18' y='82' width='60' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#C98A56'/>
  <!-- feet gripping branch -->
  <path d='M48 78 Q48 82 46 84 M52 78 Q52 82 54 84' stroke='#C99A1E' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
